splash_loading: Window to the past · Loading resources...
onboarding_intro: For the best experience, allow camera access and follow the instructions.
onb_step1_desc: Grant access when the browser requests it.
onb_step2_desc: Move the device slowly in an L shape.
onb_step3_desc: When the green frame appears, tap to start.
context_block1_text: The Darró site is not just a point on the map, but an open book spanning over 1,000 years of history...
context_block2_text: Around 550 BC, the Iberian tribe of the Cossetans chose the hill of Sant Gervasi...
context_block3_text: With the arrival of Rome around 50 BC, the ancient Iberian settlement was replaced by a luxurious Roman villa...
context_block4_text: Today, the archaeological complex of Darró is a living heritage space...
explore_site_desc: Walk through the site and activate points of interest using the AR camera.
pieces_subtitle: Discover some of the most significant objects found at Adarró.
piece_info_function: Storage and maritime transport of liquids.
help_how_text: This app lets you explore archaeological objects in 3D and view a reconstruction in AR.
help_zoom: Zoom with two fingers or the mouse wheel.
help_info: Tap the “i” to view historical information.
help_ar_step1: Press the “AR” button to activate the camera.
help_ar_step2: The villa will appear 2 meters in front of you.
help_ar_step3: Turn or move to observe it from different angles.
help_ar_step4: If the device does not support AR, it will be shown in 3D.
help_nav_home: Press “Home” to return to the main screen.
help_nav_explore: Press “Explore” to view the objects and the villa.
help_nav_help: Press “Help” to return to this screen.
help_compat_text: AR only works on devices compatible with WebXR.
